intro.text: A Thaylen ship captain who sails the Wind's Pleasure with his wife, Ashlv.

items.text: Tozbek carried Shallan Davar from Jah Keved to Kharbranth at a generous discount, because House Davar had invested in his business.
Jasnah then chose Tozbek's ship for her and Shallan's voyage from Kharbranth to the Shattered Plains. What became of him after the Wind's Pleasure sank is unknown.

appearance.text: A short, portly, bald man with long white Thaylen eyebrows stiffened into fans above his eyes, and a scar on his jaw from loose tackle.

personality.text: A calm, cautious man and an excellent sailor.
